Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped at the signal on the eastbound approach when the rear of the vehicle was struck by Driver 2,
whose vehicle was traveling at a speed consistent with the observed impact. Driver 1 reported a concussion and
stated that the head struck the interior during the collision. The injury pattern described is consistent with the force of
a rear impact of this kind. Damage to both vehicles is largely in line with the reported mechanism of impact, and
photographs taken at the scene confirm several of the details provided by the drivers. No independent witnesses
were located, and no prior damage to either vehicle was known to those interviewed. Passenger was present in the
rear seat, though it could not be fully established from statements or the scene where Driver 1 was seated at the
moment of impact. Driver 2 is not a named insured on the policy and does not reside with the policyholder, a fact
noted for the claims file. No citations were issued at the scene pending further review of the photographs and vehicle
inspections.
